message.Title: Generally Available: Azure SQL Database provisioning in MSSQL extension

Body.Content:
With Azure SQL Database provisioning, you can create and connect to a fully managed cloud database directly from your editor—at no cost. Now generally available, the feature also includes ready-to-use Azure Resource Manager (ARM), Bicep, and Terraform templates for repeatable deployments, along with additional options to help you get started faster.

 Learn more.
